facts.text: Caroline attended an LGBTQ conference two days before 12 July 2023, where she met and connected with people who have gone through similar journeys.

evidence.quote: I went to an LGBTQ conference two days ago and it was really special. I got the chance to meet and connect with people who've gone through similar journeys.

facts.text: Caroline felt accepted and supported at the LGBTQ conference, describing the environment as welcoming.

evidence.quote: I felt totally accepted. I'm really thankful for this amazing community - it's shown me how important it is to fight for trans rights and spread awareness.

facts.text: Caroline expressed a desire to help make a difference in the fight for LGBTQ rights and awareness.

evidence.quote: It's shown me how important it is to fight for trans rights and spread awareness.
I wanna help make a difference.

facts.text: Caroline is currently looking into counseling and mental health jobs to help people have someone to talk to.

evidence.quote: I'm still looking into counseling and mental health jobs. It's important to me that people have someone to talk to, and I want to help make that happen.
